title: Data testing
datasetHint: Each dataset receives its own scores and report. Selected datasets run sequentially.

runtime.title: Evaluation environment
runtime.missing: Prepare Inspect before the first test.
runtime.failed: Preparation failed. Check the network and uv, then retry.
runtime.hint: Requires uv on this computer. Downloads Python 3.12 and pinned dependencies without calling a model.

localHint: Benchmarks run on this computer, independently of the default remote runner. The first run may download datasets.
sampleHint: 0 means the full dataset. Start with a small sample.
invalid: Check the connection, select at least one dataset, and enter valid parameters.
nativeOnly: Prepare and run data tests in the desktop application.
loadError: Unable to read benchmarks. Previously loaded content is retained.
emptyHint: Choose datasets and a channel to start a test.
evaluationFailed: Evaluation did not finish completely. Completed samples remain available. Check the connection, model capabilities, and dataset access.
noMetrics: No scoring metrics are available yet
metricHint: Scores use Inspect's native metrics. Execution completion is not a capability pass verdict.
sampleError: The request or scoring failed for this sample.
fingerprintHint: Covers task inputs and reference answers. Image URLs are not image-content checksums.

datasetDescriptions.aime2025: AIME 2025 competition mathematics with repeated sampling.
datasetDescriptions.mmlu_pro: Multi-subject knowledge and reasoning, with ten answer options.
datasetDescriptions.mmmu_multiple_choice: Image-and-text multidisciplinary questions. This is MMMU, not MMMU-Pro.
